liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer counts it among favorite renditions ever [11]
- **Loser** (1 review): The first-set Loser was awesome, according to the reviewer [19]
- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): Only Me & My Uncle into Mexicali pairing of the tour, with sharp Weir licks and a Jerry MIDI solo [15]
- **Broken Arrow** (1 review): Reviewer calls it one of the finest versions the band ever played [16]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): One of the few songs the reviewer clearly remembers from the night [13]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Bobby switches to acoustic guitar, which gives the song extra punch, and the crowd responds warmly [10]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer remembers it as scary, aided by blotter taken earlier [19]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): A surprise; the later Deer Creek version was not as good [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-06-13.111953.aud.dak5245-pzm.orchardpark-ny.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 151 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd93-06-13.schoeps.ladner.8584.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 3.86/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Hot-sounding audience tape, better than many cassette soundboards, with Phil very loud and crunchy and instruments remarkably clear; Recording fidelity is exceptional, an audience tape the reviewer calls perfect; Sound quality of the recording is rated very good [10][11][14]
- **gd1993-06-13.147183.nak300-cp4.boedicker.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min [4]
- **gd1993-06-13.sbd.miller.105491.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 3.4/5 by 10 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls Jerry joining Sting and his band for a Tea in the Sahara [12]
- Locals' backyards across from the stadium turned into big parties over the two nights [12]
- Show opened with Touch of Grey, the second year in a row, disappointing the reviewer [13]
- Open-air crowd of over 80,000 made for a party atmosphere, with so-so sound [13]
- Reviewer drove from Michigan through Canada after Buckeye; the wooded area around the venue was hard to find [18]
- Reviewer funded the summer tour by selling grilled cheese and drinks, while a girlfriend made ankle bracelets [18]
- Weather was pretty nice for the show [1]
- Captures live excitement that late-era monitor mixes and soundboards often lack [10]
- Band's heart feels weaker than in years like 1977 or 1983 [14]
- Only Cassidy into Deal pairing of the tour; follows the Friday Buckeye show [15]
- Reviewer says Bobby first takes up acoustic guitar here, which later became routine, usually in first sets [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-06-13.111953.aud.dak5245-pzm.orchardpark-ny.flac16**: taped by Robert Mullen; transferred by Robert Mullen; source: Source: Master Audience cassette Transfer Date: 2011-02-15; Equipment/Lineage: 2 DAK 5245 Microphones and 2 Realistic PZM Mics(Mounted on 1'x 1'x 3/8"… [1]. Also: Audience recording made with an unusual four-microphone configuration [1]
- **gd93-06-13.schoeps.ladner.8584.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience: Schoeps CMC-32's [3]
- **gd1993-06-13.147183.nak300-cp4.boedicker.flac16**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony WM-D6C Cassette Master>2 Maxell MX-90 And MX-100 Cassette Master Tapes(1 For Each Set)>Sony TC-D5 M Cassette… [4]. Also: Taped on a Sony D6 cassette deck; attenuator adjusted after the opener as levels were starting; Tape flip after Broken Arrow, with no music missed going into Tennessee Jed [4]
- **gd1993-06-13.sbd.miller.105491.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat Master (48k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Rich Stadium](https://www.dead.net/archives/1993/clippings/backstage-pass-rich-stadium) [22]
- Poster by www.livebootleg.net: [コレクターズCD (グレトフルデッド1993年アメリカンツアー06月13日ニューヨーク )/Grateful Dead - Fall Tour 1993 Rich Stadium:Orchard Park NY June 13th 1993](https://www.livebootleg.net/SHOP/GratefulDead00019.html) [23]
- Fan art by www.livebootleg.net: [コレクターズCD (グレトフルデッド1993年アメリカンツアー06月13日ニューヨーク )/Grateful Dead - Fall Tour 1993 Rich Stadium:Orchard Park NY June 13th 1993](https://www.livebootleg.net/SHOP/GratefulDead00019.html) [24]
